items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I played under her, played under Lamille.

ctx.x: When did you take the band into the Indiana Theater?

I took the band in the Indiana Theater -- who did they have there? A girl by the name of Lamille and she left. I played under her, played under Lamille. This was -- I don't remember those dates back then. Let's see, all right. I have to go to thinking about residence, then maybe (that was still, and I left) that'll bring it -- I was living at 3730 (inaudible), round about 1941.
'41 you went to the band there?
